answer: We prove Sybil resistance by coupling dynamic opportunity-cost bonds with zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions, enforcing a super-linear staking collateral constraint on multi-identity generation. Upon identity division, a subgame-perfect slashing matrix forces the attacker's payoff trajectory into an irreversible spiral off an economic ledge, ensuring expected utility E[U_attack] < 0. Consequently, the system converges to a strict Nash equilibrium resistant to any transient zephyr of hostile capital.
